associations.rationale: The displayed formal type only introduces the auxiliary type carrying the zero-bracket construction.
The formal type asserts that the opaque Abelian wrapper is Lie-abelian, but it does not display the wrapper's zero bracket, so it does not itself state the full source claim.
The formal type supplies the Lie-algebra structure needed by the construction but does not itself assert that its bracket is zero or that it is abelian.
The formal type supplies the underlying Lie-ring structure but does not itself assert that its bracket is zero or that it is abelian.
